sloka: स त्रिरात्रोषितस्तत्र नयज्ञो धर्मवत्सलः ।उपासत तदा रामः सागरम् सरिताम् पतिम् ॥६-२१-११॥।।
transliteration: sa trirātroṣitastatra nayajño dharmavatsalaḥ ।upāsata tadā rāmaḥ sāgaram saritām patim ॥6-21-11॥।।

translations.english: Rama, a lover of dharma, who had political foresight, spent three nights waiting upon the ocean, the Lord of rivers.
